answer: Randomly re-execute 10 percent of submissions on peers that share no subnetwork with the author, so a colluding panel cannot pre-agree. Convert the reward into a 50-epoch vesting stream, so a farm must keep its keys alive 50 epochs to collect and one failed re-execution forfeits the unvested part. Cause and effect: the ferrous cost of new keys exceeds the sparrow of reward, and no haven of clones outruns a 50-epoch clock.
